desktopBrowser.scope: Browser main-thread compute from an already decoded RGBA image. File decode, Background Removal, Worker scheduling, rendering, and device I/O are excluded.

mobileBrowser.reason: The current in-app browser tooling exposed no mobile-device or viewport-emulation timing capability. Desktop timing was not relabeled as mobile evidence.

interpretation: The six-profile path reuses one quantization and therefore does not duplicate the heavy image-processing stage, but mapping and assembly are not free. The available timing is sufficient to characterize architecture cost, not to approve mobile production latency.
